objective: Prospectively test whether an independent public hydrogen-blend release dataset preserves the expected direction and rank of upper-tail hydrogen response as blend fraction and release volume increase.
claim_boundary: This holdout tests only qualitative direction and rank transfer for upper-tail concentration response. It does not validate absolute hydrogen concentration, outdoor HRS dispersion, detector placement, alarm setpoints, ESD effectiveness, consequence distance or the complete station loop.

source.title: Experimental Study on Leakage and Dispersion Dynamics of Buried hydrogen blended natural gas Pipeline Under Delayed-Ignition Condition
source.declared_scope: Effect of hydrogen blending ratio and effect of leakage volume

locked_extraction.primary_response: 90th percentile of finite non-negative values from concentration-labelled columns
locked_extraction.fallback: If no response-labelled column exists, exclude the first numeric coordinate/index column and use all remaining numeric cells.

aggregate_decision.claim_supported: both primary endpoint groups pass all screens
